uutiset.s: Latest score from the series-deciding third one-day international between Australia and England at Ninja Stadium in Hobart.

uutiset.t: England off to superb start in series-deciding ODI vs Australia LIVE!
Papers: Poch to appoint Man Utd's first-ever female coach
uutiset.s: The top stories and transfer rumours from Wednesday's newspapers...

uutiset.t: Northern Ireland promoted to Nations League top tier with draw in Hungary
uutiset.s: Justin Devenny's superb strike saw Northern Ireland earn promotion to the top tier of the Nations League with a hard-fought 1-1 draw away to closest challengers Hungary in Budapest.

uutiset.t: Parrott fires Republic of Ireland into Nations League play-offs
uutiset.s: Troy Parrott fired the Republic of Ireland into a Nations League play-off berth with two penalties in their 3-0 victory over 10-man Kosovo at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin.

uutiset.t: Wales beaten by 10-man Portugal as Neto scores but is sent off
uutiset.s: Wales ended their Nations League group campaign with a 3-2 defeat against 10-man Portugal in Cardiff after Chelsea's Pedro Neto was sent off.

uutiset.t: Ecclestone ruled out of Women's Big Bash League
uutiset.s: Sophie Ecclestone has been ruled out of the remainder of the WBBL season due to a back injury.

uutiset.t: Jockey De Boinville 'escorted to his vehicle' after threat received
uutiset.s: Nico de Boinville was given security support at Plumpton on Monday after a threat against the jockey was received and passed on to authorities.

uutiset.t: JJ Gabriel says goodbye to Man Utd with Real Madrid move close
uutiset.s: JJ Gabriel has announced he is leaving Manchester United as he looks forward to his "next chapter" at Real Madrid.

uutiset.t: Scholes ruled out for season with injury
uutiset.s: Alicia Scholes has been ruled out of the remainder of the 2026 season after she suffered a ruptured ACL during a training camp with England's Vitality Roses.

uutiset.t: A clash to savour at Ffos Las on Wednesday
uutiset.s: Cheltenham's loss is Ffos Las' gain on Wednesday as old rivals Old Park Star, Sober Glory and Baron Noir are set to face-off on chase debut and At The Races' Declan Rix previewed the contest.

uutiset.t: Arsenal close to new deals for Raya, Timber and Hincapie
uutiset.s: Arsenal are close to finalising new deals with David Raya, Jurrien Timber and Piero Hincapie.

uutiset.t: Van Gerwen sneaks into last 16 of Grand Slam and sets up Wade clash
uutiset.s: Michael van Gerwen squeaked into the last 16 of the Grand Slam of Darts to set up a clash with James Wade, who had a comfortable 5-0 win over Ricky Evans.

uutiset.t: Zverev books place in ATP Finals semi-finals
uutiset.s: Alexander Zverev booked his spot in the knockout stages of the ATP Finals after sealing a ruthless 6-2 7-6 (7-4) victory over Ben Shelton in Turin on Tuesday night, in a rematch of this year's US Open final.

uutiset.t: Mercedes set to run ADUO engine upgrade in Las Vegas with one driver
uutiset.s: World champions Mercedes will bring their ADUO turbocharger upgrade to this weekend's Las Vegas Grand Prix, although George Russell will not use it to avoid having to take another grid penalty in his bid for second place in the Drivers' Championship.
